A search coil is moved from a region of uniform magnetic field to a region of zero flux in a time interval . This process induces an average electromotive force (emf) and causes a total charge to flow through the coil. The process is repeated, but the coil is now moved out of the same magnetic field in a time interval .

Which of the following correctly identifies the average induced emf and the total charge flow for the second process?

Average induced emfTotal charge flow
A.halvedhalved
B.halvedunchanged
C.unchangedhalved
D.doubledunchanged
